events.description: Creation of the initial square, its nested shadow layers, the center dot, and the side/diagonal lines with labels '1' and '\sqrt{N}'.
events.clip_query: A square with nested shadow lines, a horizontal blue line labeled 1, and a diagonal yellow line labeled square root of N.

events.description: Warping animation where the square, shadows, and lines transform into curved, hyperbolic-like shapes.
events.clip_query: The square and its shadows warping into curved, hyperbolic shapes while the lines stretch to follow.

events.description: Addition of 4 corner circles at the warped square's vertices, followed by the expansion of a central circle touching them.
events.clip_query: Four small blue circles appearing at the corners of the warped square, followed by a large green circle expanding from the center.

events.description: Rotational replication of the warped square and corner circles to represent 2^N corners, accompanied by a camera zoom-out.
events.clip_query: Multiple rotated copies of the warped square and circles sweeping into view to form a dense multi-dimensional projection with a label reading 2^N corners.
